WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__, (value->>'s')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_START_TIME__

       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "purchased_at"
FROM TMP
JOIN "parity_marketplace"."purchases"
  ON "customer_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "purchased_at" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND "purchased_at" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "purchased_at", "purchase_id"

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value #>> '{}')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__

)
SELECT * FROM (
